integrity: The proof reduces every Roman {3} constraint to two exact layer-sum inequalities, then derives sharp lower bounds and equality conditions. A standalone verifier performs direct graph-level brute force for n=4,5 and a separate exact aggregate dynamic program through n=60.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to K_n square K_2 with n at least four.
The small cases n=2,3 are excluded because they have separate extremal behavior.
No formula is claimed for K_n square K_m with m at least three or for connected double Italian domination.
Full brute force is used only for n=4,5; the all-n proof is symbolic and the aggregate dynamic program is corroborative.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed complete-prism formula.
title: Roman \(\{3\}\)-domination of complete prisms
